source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide whether a situation is directly proportional before applying the Rule of Three.
node_labels: Number: magnitude, representation and arithmetic structure

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Rule of Three is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide whether a situation is directly proportional before applying' is answered as Rule of Three rather than direct proportion.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Rule of Three is what produces direct proportion, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide whether a situation is directly proportional.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: direct proportion is settled by running 'Divide a whole in a given ratio by treating the ratio terms as numbers': To divide a whole x in the ratio m : n, first find one group's size x/(m+n), then form the — on the item about Decide whether a situation is directly proportional.

intelligence.enrichment: The Rule of Three applies when changing one quantity by a factor changes the corresponding quantity by the same factor; it does not apply as a direct proportion when one quantity increases while the other must decrease.
